currentProblem.title: Emergency Response Without the Internet
currentProblem.description: During a major disaster such as a flood, cyclone, or earthquake, mobile networks and internet connectivity may become unavailable. Emergency teams still need to identify people who need help, prioritize locations, and coordinate rescue operations.
currentProblem.challenge: Design a system that can identify, prioritize, and coordinate emergency assistance without relying on normal internet connectivity.
currentProblem.twist: No Internet — the solution must work without normal internet connectivity.
